newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat futures end steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat futures end steady to lower.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended steady to lower, with March pressured by light hedge-related selling, traders said. Volumes were light during the shortened pre-holiday session.

But traders said losses had been kept in check by mill buying and a drop in deliverable wheat stocks in Minneapolis and Duluth. Cash movement was slow ahead of the holiday and amid near-blizzard conditions in western Minnesota.
MGE spring wheat futures closed steady to 1-1/2 cents per bushel lower, with March down 1-1/4 cent at $3.86-1/2. May lost 1-1/2 cent to close at $3.73.
Traders said Atwood-Peavey bought 500,000 March bushels and Wilson bought 300,000 to 400,000 May. Country Hedging sold at least 200,000 March.
MGE barley closed steady to five cents per cwt higher. Nearby March did not trade.
MGE agricultural futures will not trade on Wednesday in observance of the Christmas holiday.
